shipped_rows.title_o: Increasing Teachers’ Use of Behavior-Specific Praise Using a Multitiered System for Professional Development

blind_target.evidence_quote: In this study, we replicated a targeted professional development approach that included a brief one‐on‐one training session and emailed visual performance feedback to increase novice teachers’ use of behavior‐specific praise, an evidence‐based classroom management skill.
